title: webauthn-conformance-report acceptance evidence

preconditions.const: Operations: identity.mfa.security-key-register-options, identity.mfa.security-key-register-verify, identity.mfa.security-key-assert-options, identity.mfa.security-key-assert-verify, identity.passkey.register-verify, identity.passkey.signin-verify; exact inputs: rp_id, origin, challenge, credential_response, user_verification, backup_eligible, backup_state, stored_sign_count, received_sign_count; initial state: pinned WebAuthn fixtures cover valid and hostile authenticator data for non-backup security keys and backup-eligible passkeys

stimulus.const: Run identity.mfa.security-key-register-options then identity.mfa.security-key-register-verify then identity.mfa.security-key-assert-options then identity.mfa.security-key-assert-verify then identity.passkey.register-verify then identity.passkey.signin-verify for success, failure, denial, replay, cleanup cases using rp_id, origin, challenge, credential_response, user_verification, backup_eligible, backup_state, stored_sign_count, received_sign_count and capture every required artifact field

expected_outcome.const: Invariant: exact BE and BS execution accepts false/false, rejects false/true, and accepts true/false and true/true; both non-backup and backup-eligible authenticator paths execute; the exact zero, positive increase, equal, decrease, and received-zero counter matrix follows the selected policy, persists backup state on every valid assertion, never rolls counters back, emits bounded risk evidence for backup-eligible non-increase, and denies non-backup positive non-increase; stable outcomes: success=pass/none, failure=failed/internal, denial=denied/forbidden, replay=denied/conflict, cleanup=pass/none; required artifact fields: backup_state_matrix, authenticator_path_ids, authenticator_path_results, signature_counter_matrix, backup_state_case_count, valid_backup_state_case_count, rejected_backup_state_case_count, authenticator_path_count, counter_case_count, conformance_case_count, passed_case_count, credential_id, sign_count, fixture_digest

actual_outcome.const: Invariant: exact BE and BS execution accepts false/false, rejects false/true, and accepts true/false and true/true; both non-backup and backup-eligible authenticator paths execute; the exact zero, positive increase, equal, decrease, and received-zero counter matrix follows the selected policy, persists backup state on every valid assertion, never rolls counters back, emits bounded risk evidence for backup-eligible non-increase, and denies non-backup positive non-increase; stable outcomes: success=pass/none, failure=failed/internal, denial=denied/forbidden, replay=denied/conflict, cleanup=pass/none; required artifact fields: backup_state_matrix, authenticator_path_ids, authenticator_path_results, signature_counter_matrix, backup_state_case_count, valid_backup_state_case_count, rejected_backup_state_case_count, authenticator_path_count, counter_case_count, conformance_case_count, passed_case_count, credential_id, sign_count, fixture_digest

x-cross-field-rules: every observations[].artifact_sha256 value must equal one artifact_hashes[].sha256 value
artifact_hashes must bind the artifact-specific evidence object at .ai/identity-platform/evidence/artifacts/webauthn-conformance-report.json
artifact_hashes must bind the separately captured coordinator execution receipt at .ai/identity-platform/evidence/executions/webauthn-conformance-report.json
revalidation_revision is null exactly when tested_revision equals gate_execution_revision; otherwise it equals gate_execution_revision
input_root is SHA-256 over RFC 8785 canonical JSON of input_manifest
